a.lede: Dutch police have confirmed that a 24-year-old Amsterdam man arrested earlier this month was detained as part of an investigation into the ShinyHunters hacking group. [...]
a.title: Dutch police confirm arrest in ShinyHunters hacking investigation

b.lede: Dutch police said the hacker, arrested for being part of the ShinyHunters cybercriminal gang, had plans to organize the murder of two people on his laptop.
b.title: Dutch police arrest ShinyHunters hacker accused of planning two murders
